title: CISA KEV remediation deadlines: TrueConf Server flaws (CVE-2026-72529, CVE-2026-72530)
summary: CISA added two actively exploited TrueConf Server vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on August 20, 2026; federal agencies must remediate the missing-authentication flaw (CVE-2026-72529) by August 23 and the code-injection flaw (CVE-2026-72530) by September 2.

sources.title: CISA Adds Two Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
CISA Urges Immediate Patching of Exploited TrueConf Vulnerabilities

title: CISA KEV remediation deadlines: Citrix NetScaler, SQL Server and four legacy flaws
summary: CISA added six actively exploited vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on August 26, 2026; federal agencies must remediate a Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway memory-corruption flaw (CVE-2026-8452) and a Microsoft SQL Server RCE (CVE-2019-1068) by August 29, and four older flaws (Linux kernel, Red Hat libuser/ABRT, Ajax.NET Professional) by September 9.

sources.title: CISA Adds Six Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
CISA Adds Six Exploited Flaws to KEV, Including NetScaler, Linux, and SQL Server Bugs

title: CISA KEV remediation deadline: Linux Kernel IPv6 flaw (CVE-2026-53362)
summary: Federal civilian executive branch agencies must remediate the actively exploited Linux Kernel IPv6 out-of-bounds write vulnerability by this date under CISA's KEV catalog requirements.

sources.title: CISA Adds Three Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog

title: OpenAI retires the official DALL·E GPT from ChatGPT
summary: OpenAI is retiring the original DALL·E GPT in ChatGPT, directing users to ChatGPT Images instead; users are advised to download any images they want to keep beforehand. User-created GPTs with image generation remain unaffected.

sources.title: You have until August 30 to save your ChatGPT DALL-E images

title: Anthropic warns of Claude session hijacking via infostealers
summary: Anthropic disclosed that infostealer malware is stealing Claude login session cookies to bypass 2FA and drain usage, and said it is proactively signing out affected users, clearing saved payment methods, and refunding unauthorized charges.

sources.title: Anthropic warns infostealer malware is hijacking Claude sessions to drain usage
Anthropic locks out Claude users after infostealers hijack login sessions

title: GitHub Spark access ends for existing users
summary: GitHub retires Spark entirely: after accepting no new users or apps since August 4, existing users lose the ability to access or export apps from Spark on this date.

sources.title: Upcoming deprecation of GitHub Spark on github.com

title: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 preview model shuts down
summary: Google is shutting down the gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview model in the Gemini API; developers are directed to migrate to newer robotics models.

title: Palo Alto Networks retires IBM-acquired QRadar EDR/XDR, X-Force TI, Randori Attack and QRadar Advisor with Watson
summary: The IBM-origin QRadar Suite EDR/XDR, X-Force Threat Intelligence, Randori Attack, and QRadar Advisor with Watson SaaS products reach end of life and lose support.

title: Runway launches Solaris interface world model
summary: Runway announced Solaris, which it calls its first "Interface World Model": a real-time model that generates interactive app interfaces frame-by-frame from a prompt with no code.

sources.title: Runway Solaris Launches: App Interfaces Now Run Live in Video, Zero Code
